people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus answered him, “Do you say this by yourself, or did others tell you about me?”
translations.bsb: “Are you saying this on your own,” Jesus asked, “or did others tell you about Me?”
translations.kjv: Jesus answered him, Sayest thou this thing of thyself, or did others tell it thee of me?
translations.asv: Jesus answered, Sayest thou this of thyself, or did others tell it thee concerning me?
